name: Level 1: A1 Fondamenta
description: Master the 2 foundational pillars (Essere & Avere), articles, and preposition contractions.

name: Level 2: A2 Struttura
description: Modal verbs (potere, volere, dovere), Passato Prossimo (ha fatto, è andato), and the universal connector 'CHE'.

name: Level 3: B1 Transizione
description: Imperfetto ('V' past), Passato Remoto for historical texts, Passive voice intro, and the 'CUI' relative connector.

name: Level 4: B2 YDS Accademia
description: The 25 Master Connectors (Sebbene, Tuttavia, Poiché) and 25 Research Argumentation Verbs with 3rd-person Tense Decoders.
